map.：内撕裂反映纤维间结合，边撕裂反映边缘抗裂；两者量级差大（比值 2.00）提示边: : internal tear reflects fiber bonding while edge tear reflects edge crack resistance; the large gap (ratio 2.00) means the edge is weaker, so watch for cracking in die-cutting and slitting.
map.内撕裂和边撕裂分别说明什么？: What do internal tear and edge tear each show?
map.内撕裂(内部撕裂度)主要表征纤维结合强度，边撕裂(边撕裂)表征边缘抗起始裂口能力: Internal tear mainly characterizes fiber bonding strength, while edge tear characterizes the edge's resistance to initiating a tear. Packaging resistance to handling damage depends more on edge tear, while printed surface strength relates to internal bonding.

map.常用 mN（毫牛顿）。撕裂对纹向敏感，标准规定纵向/横向取样；对比时务必同方向，: mN (millinewton) is the common unit. Tear is sensitive to grain direction; sample longitudinally/transversely as specified, and always compare in the same direction.
